info.title: Artistic Hub API
info.description: Artistic Hub API: public catalog, customer accounts, cart, checkout and orders, and the admin API under /admin.

get.description: The default address comes first, then the newest.

post.description:
The customer's first address becomes the default automatically. Send `is_default: true` to make a
later one the default; the previous default then stops being the default.

put.description:
Only the customer's own addresses can be changed; any other id returns 404. Past orders keep their own copy.
Send `is_default: true` to make it the default (the previous one stops being default). Sending
`is_default: false` for the current default returns 422: make another address the default instead.

patch.description: The previous default stops being the default. Only the customer's own addresses; any other id returns 404.

get.description:
Customers only (no admins, no deleted accounts), paginated. Search matches name, email and phone.
The response also has `filters` (the filters applied, with defaults filled in) and
`filter_options` (the values `sort` accepts).

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

and `filter_options`.

post.description: Upload photos first with POST /admin/uploads/variant-photos and send the returned ids as variants.*.photo_ids.
post.summary: Create a product with its variants

get.summary: View a product with its variants, photos and tags

put.description:
Send the whole product: variants with a `public_id` are updated, without one are created, and variants not
sent are deleted. Turning the product off turns every variant off. Photos not sent are deleted with their files.
put.summary: Save a product with all its variants

delete.description: Deletes its variants, photos (and their files) and tag links. Past orders keep their own copy.

Removes it right away (outside the product form), with its photos and tag links. A product must keep at
least one variant (409). An id that is not this product's variant returns 404.

post.description: Sets the customer's name and profile details. A customer has one profile; sending this again returns 409.
multipart/form-data with an `avatar` file. Replaces any previous avatar. Returns the profile with the new `avatar_url`.

Creates an active customer account from email and password only. No token is returned: the
customer signs in next, then creates their profile.
Only customer accounts can sign in here; admin accounts get the same error as a wrong password.
Only admin accounts can sign in here; customer accounts get the same error as a wrong password.

post.summary: Create a tag. A name already used (ignoring case) returns 422

put.summary: Rename a tag (everywhere it is used)

delete.summary: Delete a tag. It is removed from every variant; the variants stay

post.description:
multipart/form-data with `photos[]`: 1 to 8 files. Stores each one, not yet attached to any variant, and
returns them in the order sent, each with its media `id` (send the ids in the product save under
variants.*.photo_ids) and `url` (for the preview). If any file is invalid, none is stored (422 names the
file, e.g. photos.2). Photos never attached to a variant are deleted automatically after 24 hours.

delete.description:
Deletes the photo and its file right away: one on a saved variant (its other photos keep their order), or
one uploaded and removed from the form before saving. Any admin can delete any variant photo; an id that is
not a variant photo returns 404.

SaveProductRequest.description:
The whole product, sent on every save (create and update): product fields plus every variant it
should have. Variants with a `public_id` are updated, without one are created, and variants not sent are
deleted. Photos are media ids returned by POST /admin/uploads/variant-photos, in display order.
Every id here is a client-facing public id (ULID); toData() turns them into internal ids.

is_active.description: Turning the product off turns every variant off.

public_id.description: The variant's public_id; leave out for a new variant.

name.description: Unique within this product, ignoring case (other products may use the same name).

description.description: Falls back to the product description when null.

selling_price.description: Rupees, up to 2 decimals; must not be more than original_price.

photo_ids.description: Up to 8 media ids per variant (from POST /admin/uploads/variant-photos), in display order; the first is the cover.
